restaurant_name: Dr. Jaruk's Ear, Nose and Throat Clinic
text:
The first time I came, I encountered a queue taker. As I thought about it, another patient arrived at the same time. He had gotten his turn but couldn't find his card. He turned to me and said, "Go ahead, son." I thanked him and went to sign in. The staff member in a very curt tone said, "Sign in!!" Since it was my first time, I asked, "Would you like to take your medical history?" He replied, "Go sit down!"

Until it was my turn, I gave my medical history late, and the queue taker told me to jump the queue. At that moment, I didn't think I was jumping the queue. Maybe I was just being too stingy. Honestly, the queue taker could have just told me to leave my name in the queue for you earlier. We were very happy to help. We didn't want to cause any problems. We were just here for treatment. The first person told us to go first, son, so I went to sign in. If I was wrong to leave my name in the queue for that person earlier, you can switch. I was fine with that. No problem. I can wait. We can tell you. We're quite understanding. But you shouldn't have acted so disrespectfully towards us. // We understand working with a lot of people, but doing this not only makes you look bad, but also damages your organization's reputation.

I sincerely thank that patient for telling me to sign in first. I sincerely apologize to the patient who didn't write down their name to leave their appointment (you were scheduled ahead of us for that day's treatment), which I'm very comfortable with. You deserved to be there first. 🙏🏻🥹) Thank you again for your kindness. May you be healthy. 🙏🏻🥹

The doctor treated me very well. He was friendly, easy to talk to, relieved my anxiety, and provided excellent assistance to my patients. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

restaurant_name: Dr. Jaruk's Ear, Nose and Throat Clinic
text: There were a lot of customers, so I had to wait. There were comfortable waiting seats. The clinic was not air-conditioned. The doctor was very attentive and examined me thoroughly. I was impressed.

restaurant_name: Dr. Jaruk's Ear, Nose and Throat Clinic
text:
The clinic is busy, but for me, he's the best ENT specialist in town. I'm a local, and I always see him at Sripat Hospital and this clinic when I'm not in the hospital. Dr. Charuk is very generous and kind. His prescription medicine is in its original packaging, so you know exactly what you're taking.
For general symptoms, the doctor examines quickly because there are many patients, but he is thorough. If you have questions, he answers them meticulously and patiently.
The doctor is very kind and skilled. Another thing I like is that the medicine he prescribes is clearly labeled and comes with its original packaging. This makes me feel secure knowing the quality of the medication is good. I don't have to guess what brand or type of medicine the doctor is prescribing. The price isn't any more expensive than regular pharmacies. If the doctor wants to examine me with equipment that the clinic doesn't have, he will refer me to Sripat Hospital.

restaurant_name: Dr. Jaruk's Ear, Nose and Throat Clinic
